qa_pairs.question: What types of usage statistics are available for individual virtual machines in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Each virtual machine in the Metrix portal offers usage statistics for CPU cores, memory, disk bandwidth, IOPS (input/output operations per second), and network bandwidth.

qa_pairs.question: For what time periods can users view the usage statistics of their virtual machines?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can view the usage statistics for their virtual machines for the last month, week, day, or hour.
